# rixl_chapters (Data Source)

Retrieves all navigational chapter markers configured for a video.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_chapters" "intro_chapters" {
  video_id = var.rixl_video_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `video_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `chapters` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chapters))

<a id="nestedatt--chapters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chapters`

Read-Only:

- `title` (String)
